name: checkmate
resume: All 370 exports of checkmate 2.3.4 are translated. Expectations use the testthat failure message, and register_test_backend can select the tinytest result. data.table, R6, and tibble are recognized by class; those packages are not translated.

functions.done: Returns the right-hand value when the left-hand value is NULL.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(checkmate))
fn <- function(x) x
one <- function() NULL %??% 1
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import statistics
import time
from datetime import date as D

from checkmate import *
from checkmate.rtypes import NA

    return x

from datetime import date as D

from checkmate import *
from checkmate.rtypes import NA

def fn(x):
    return x

letters = list('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
DAY = (D(2020, 1, 2) - D(1970, 1, 1)).days

def one():
    return assertTRUE(True)

one()
elapsed = []

    one()
